feeds.title: babyballet®
feeds.description: babyballet is a Preschool dance classes for children from 6 months to 6 years. Award-winning dance classes for boys & girls from 6 months to 6 years. Licenses available in NZ!

feeds.title: Salsa Latina Blog
feeds.description: Salsa Latina Dance Academy Christchurch, offers Salsa, Bachata & Kizomba dance classes for Adults. Learn from New Zealand Salsa Champions. Learn more about salsa and other 'street' Latin dance forms, tips, tutorials and more!

feeds.title: ConnectEd Dance Blog
feeds.description: Connecting kids to the incredible developmental benefits of dance education! Gain fresh insight about our studio, dance, tips, and more from Liahona ConnectEd Dance founder, a mum, and a passionate dance educator. Liahona holds a master's Degree in Health Sport and Human Performance (First Class Honors) from the University of Waikato, studying community dance education.

feeds.title: Shut Up & Dance Blog
feeds.description: Follow the Shut Up & Dance Blog and For news and updates or quick-fire-rounds with our fast-growing team and content that makes you chuckle, have a browse and get yourself lost in the depths of our pop-fueled brains.

feeds.title: Jenna McKenzie School of Dance Blog
feeds.description: Jenna McKenzie School of Dance strives to build confidence and a passion for dance in a fun and magical environment

feeds.title: Auckland Academy of Dance
feeds.description: The Auckland Academy of Dance is one of New Zealand's leading dance academies, providing high caliber training for preschool to professional dancers. They offer classes for all ages, from mums-n-bubs, preschool children, school-aged students primary to advanced, and up to adult classes.

feeds.title: Ceroc Dance New Zealand
feeds.description: Ceroc Dance is a brand of modern jive dance, a social partner dance generally done to chart toppers and old favourites. It is a partner dance that you can dance at parties, pubs, nightclubs, weddings; just about anywhere!

feeds.title: Footnote New Zealand Dance
feeds.description: Founded by Deirdre Tarrant in 1985, Footnote is an ambitious national arts organization that is dedicated to enriching Aotearoa by amplifying dance as an artform. Follow their news page and Stay up to date with all of Footnote's workshops, job openings, auditions, news and more.

feeds.title: The Dance Company
feeds.description: The Dance Company provides various forms of dance classes and has amazing offers packed for their students. Visit their informative website for articles on their dance company, their dance styles, classes offered, dance-related events, and more.

feeds.title: Dance Mums Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to this hilarious, yet informative blog for dance parents! The struggles of coordinating costumes, keeping track of competition dates and making sure their little dancers are always on point (literally and figuratively) are well known.But have no fear, this blog is here to make the dance parent journey a little bit easier, and a lot more entertaining.So put on those legwarmers, grab a cup of tea, and get ready for some serious dance parent realness.

feeds.title: UCan2 Dance Studio Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're wanting to learn Ballroom, Latin American or Street Latin, whatever the style and whatever your dancing level, UCan2 Dance Studio can help. Whether you're interested in classes, private lessons, learning a wedding dance or ready to dance competitively, they have got you!

feeds.title: Sugarfoot Stomp Blog
feeds.description: Sugarfoot Stomp is a Wellington Swing Dance Incorporated Society with Charitable Status. the blog shares information about the dance society, classes, events, Dance Styles and Techniques and more related topics.

feeds.title: Aurora Dance Studio Blog
feeds.description: Aurora Dance Studio offers Classical Ballet, Jazz and Contemporary dance classes for all ages and abilities. Located in Izone, Rolleston.

feeds.title: Pacific Dance New Zealand
feeds.description: Pacific Dance NZ development organization for the Pacific Dance sector of NZ. Annual programming includes a Festival, Artist in Residence & Choreographic Lab.

feeds.title: Never Stop Dancing Blog
feeds.description: At NSD they offer fun dance fitness classes, in Wellington New Zealand, and online to the world. MUSIC you LOVE, MOVES that rock, & genuinely FUN fitness. Head to their blog and learn Lots of information about Never Stop Dancing dance fitness classes, learning dance online, and so much more.

feeds.title: Stepz Dance Studio
feeds.description: Stepz Dance Studio is a social and professional dance studio that caters to all levels and ambitions. National dance champions Michael & Sonia have taught thousands of students from all age groups and skill levels, with students carrying on to become New Zealand Champions.

feeds.title: The Renaissance School of Dance Blog
feeds.description: The Renaissance School of Dance is one of the leading dance schools in Papatoetoe, Auckland. They aim to encourage a widespread love of dance as they nurture their students' confidence and self-esteem. Follow their dance blog Keep yourself updated in the world of dance. Read about news, stories, and many more.

feeds.title: RNZB
feeds.description: The Royal New Zealand Ballet (RNZB) is a company of dynamic dancers from diverse backgrounds, performing a broad repertoire for audiences at home and abroad, whilst continuing to build a style that is unique to Aotearoa. Since June 2017, the company has been under the artistic direction of Patricia Barker.
